159)༄/zas chos rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang bskur gyi las rim ltas chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so/ /160)༄༅/rigs rnams kun ci skyabs bdag gu ru

tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ zas chos rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang bskur gyi las rim ltas chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so// 160) ༄༅/ rigs rnams kun ci skyabs bdag gu ru rje/ gsal stong rang mdangs rta phag */ rang rig ngo bo rtogs pa'i phyag bgyis nas/ de yi dbang gi las rim bklag chog bri/ 'dir rig 'dzin chen po hūm̐ nag me 'bar gyis nyang lung lha ri snying po nas gter gyi dngos grub tu bzhes pa'i zab chos rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur ji ltar bya ba'i tshul sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum gyi dang po la/ gnas kyi khyad par skye bo dang dam med snod min gyis dben pa'i sgrub khar yid dang mthun par/ gsang sngags bla med kyi zab don ma dbang 'byor gdengs ldan gyi bla mas/ slob ma dad dam gyis 'byor pa'i snod ldan gyi gsol ba 161) btab pa'i dus bzang por/ dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba rgyas par spro na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor spyi mthun sgo bzhi rta babs 'khor yug dur khrod pad rdor me ris mtshan pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog gi lte bar zla gam dmar po mdun sgo gcig dang ldan par bya ste/ tshul 'di ni gzhung 'dir zhal ma gsal yang rta mgrin gyi rgyud rnams kyi dgongs pa yin la/ gal te rdul mtshon dkyil 'khor mi bzhengs na 'bru'i tshom bu lnga pa gtso bo gsum 'gyur gyis che bar bkod pas rung ba nyid do/ de'i steng gi dbus su khri'u'am man rji'i khar bum pa mtshan ldan mgul 'chings dmar po kha rgyan gzungs thag can bum chu la lnga tshan lnga'i khar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsnan pa'i bum rdzas so lnga pa btab pa 162) bsham/ mdun du kā pa la mtshan dang ldan par dza gad mngar gsum sbyar ba blug pa'i khar dar dmar gyis bka' la bzhag g.yas phyogs su rdo rje dril bu lhan cig dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon du ḍā ma ru dang thod khrag rgyab tu rtsa gsum gcig drel gyi gtor ma dang dpal gtor zung gsum me ri dang rtse mor rta mgos mtshan zhing zhabs su pad+ma 'dab bzhi can kha dog dmar po la dkar rgyan mdzes tshon dar gyi gdugs phub pa byas pa bsham/

de dag gi phyir sgor du sman rakā gtor ma phyi nang gsang mchod tshogs kyi yo byad dang bcas pa gya nom par bsham zhing*/ gzhan yang sa rgyan gnam rgyan bris sku sogs bkra shi la bag dro byin chags kyi bkod pa dang ldan par bya ba ni cho ga'o/ de nas dngos gzhi thog mar slob dpon gyi bsnyen pa kha gso zhing dbang rdzas yo byad byin rlabs nus ldan du sgrub phyir cho ga'i las rim ni/ slob dpon rang nyid tshogs bsag nga sgrib sbyong gi slad du 'di nyid kyi phyi sgrub nas gsungs pa ltar/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la rnam pa bcom ldan 'das kyi cha byad can la ltung bshags kyi sangs rgyas sum 163) cu rtsa lnga skyabs gnas dkon mchog thams cad kyis bskor ba gsal btab la/ skyabs sem phyag 'tshal yan lag bdu pa sogs kyi tshogs bsags cing*/ mthar/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la bstim nas stong nyid kyi don la mnyam par bzhag de'i ngang nas lta ba'i mtshams gcod nas bzungs te las byang gi gzhung bsrang nas bdag byin gyis brlab cing*/ bzlas pa'i skabs la babs tshe/ bdag nid rta phag yums rigs bdag gu ru dang bcas pa gsal ba'i ngang nas lha gsum ga'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las khyad par du rta mgrin gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'og tu hrīḥdang phag mo la yig steng gnyis ka dmar gsal me 'od lta bu'i yab kyi hrīḥl sngags 'phreng rnams g.yas skor du mdar hraṃ me bar 'khor ba las 'od 'phros pas/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor yang bdag bskyed ji ltar skad cig gis gsal btab pa'i thug srog gi 'od zer bdag skyed kyi thugs dkar phog pas/ bdag gis sngags 'phreng rnams gyin du nar gyi byung ste yab kyi zhal nas yum gyi zhal du zhugs shing yum gyi gsang ba nas yab kyi gsang bar brgyud 164) de thugs ka nas phar 'phros pa mdun bskyed kyi thug ka dang zhal dang sku'i dbyibs brgyud nas thugs ka las tshur byung ba bdag gi thugs kar snga bzhin thog pa'i ting nge 'dzin yengs med kyi bzlas pa ci mang bya zhing*/

thun 'jug tu dbang rdzas bum pa sogs tha dad re re layang rnam pa rdzas de dang de'i tshul la ngo bo lha ru pa la bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyi phag pa tsam gyis so so'i nus pa skyed nas byin rlabs mthun ldan du gyur par mos la/ de ltar cho ga bzlas pa dag bcas pa'i sgo nas dbang gi sgrub pa zhag dang yun skabs ci rigs par byas pa'i mthar mdun skyed dbang rdzas dang bcas pa'i lha chogs kyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs srog hrīḥm dang bcas pa las 'od zer bdag gi gnas so sor thim pas dbang rnams yongs rdzogs skad cig la thob par mos la/ bdag mdun tha dad du 'dzin pa'i rtog ri mo rang yal mnyam nyid chen por la bzla ba ni bdag 'jug gi mchog rab phul du gyur pa'o/ ༈ de nas slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi rim pa dngos ni/ dbang gzhung nyid las/ dang por sngon 'gro la bgegs gtor btang 165) drag sngags brjod cing bsrung bzlog bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ slob ma rnams gral du 'khod pa'i mdun du/ ngar glud 'chang bu dang bcas la chab kyis dbran pa bzhag ste/ slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ oṃ bh+rum̐ tram̐ hrīḥ.aḥ oṃ las 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ bh+rūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang*/ tram̐ las sna tshogs rat+na'i snod/ hrīḥlas gsung dbyangs drug cu ste/ āḥlas ci 'dod phun sum tshogs/ so sor dga' 'gu tshim byed pa'i/ 'dod dgu'i yo byad chen por gyur/ na mo/ dkon mchog thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thus ye shes rdo rje chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pas/ deng 'dir rdo rje'i slob bu rnams lam smin byed zab mor dkri bar byed pa la bar du gcod cing log par 'dren pa'i bgegs rigs 'khrul rtog gi rang gzugs a 'thas ji snyed yod pa thams cad 166)'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa'i glu gtor 'dis tshim par byos la/

'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig gal te mi 'gro na dbang chen khro rgyal 'bar ba'i mthu stobs 'od zer drag por khrug pas khyed kyi lus ngag yid gsum rdul phran phye mar rlag par 'gyur ta re/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta kṛtā badz+ra kro bha ha ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ sarba bhū ta u ts+tsha ṭa ya phaṭaḥ ces/ thun dang ting 'dzin rol mo drag pos bskrad la/ ting nge 'dzin las sprul pa'i mtshon cha'i ra ba me'i gur khang dang bcas pa spro zhing*/ rnam rtogs mtshan 'dzin gyi bgegs ni rang sems ka dag chen pos bsrung ste/ hrīḥ nga ni khro rgyal rta mgrin te/ rta skad rngams sgro bar chad sel/ sku yi 'od zer mtshon cha'i gur/ me ri 'bar bas phyogs mtshams gcod/ ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams/ rnam rtogs ma rig bag chags kyis/ lha dang 'dre bgegs bzhes snang yang*/ 167)rnam par rtogs pa'i bgegs yin phyir/ 'dre bgegs rang gi sems las byung*/ sems nyid chos sku'i don rtogs na/ bgegs dang bar chad ga la yod/ thams cad rang grol chos sku'i mtshams/ 'di las su yang 'da' ma byed/ shu n+yā ta rak+ṣa hūm̐/ de nas slob ma rnams kyi maṇ+ḍal rgyas par 'bul ba'i rjes su slob dpon gyis zab mo'i chos bshad pa'i rim pa yang rgyas par spro na dal 'byor rnyed dka' zhing 'jig par sla ba'i tshul dang*/ las 'bras bzlu med 'khor ba'i bskul thar pa'i phan son/ theg pa'i bye brag gsang sngags kyi che ba sogs skal bsdun 'chad par bya zhing*/ mdor bsdu na 'di ltar 'chad de/ nam mkha' gar khyab kyi sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi gong yangs la 'god pa'i ched kho nar/ rtsa gsum gcig dril rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang bskur zab mo gsan snyam pa'i 'dun pa sngon du btang nas yengs med du dgongs 168)mdzod/ de la spyir phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba rab 'byams ma lus pa gdul bya'i snang ngor zhing dang sku dang mdzad pa'i phrin las sna tshogs su bstan kyang don dam chos sku bde ba chen po thig le nyag gcig ye shes klong yangs chen por dbyer med par bzhugs pa de nyid 'khor 'das thams cad kyi sngon rol du byang chub pa'i don gyis/

dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po ces kyang bya/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag tu gyur phyir rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po ces kyang bya/ gdul bya'i log par rtogs pa mus thugs rje'i khro tshul gyis tshar gcod par mdzad phyir dpal he ru ka zhes kyang bya ste/ sangs rgyas ma lus lus pa med pa'i ngo bo nyid du dus bzhi 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang du bzhugs so/ de'i tshe ro shig gi dus na khams gsum sems can gyi las non bag chags par mthu brtas pa'i rang gzugs las grub pa'i sems can 169)chen po ma tram̐ rū tra'aṃ drag po 'jig byed ces bya ba ma rungs gdug pa can zhig 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir byung ste/ sngon nas rgyal ba'i bka' gsang sngags zab mo la zhugs kyang gab pa'i gsang ba ma rtogs shing sbas pa'i gsang ba mngon par 'chal te sbyor sgrol log min du spyad pas las kyi mtha' log ltar ba'i gdongs 'chug cing spyod pa'i blang dor phyin ci logs pa nyon mongs kyi rtsal rgyas te/ zhe sdang gi me 'bar bas byang sems kyi chu rgyun skam/ 'dod chags kyi mtsho 'khrug pas thar pa'i gru bo nub/ gti mug gi mun pa thibs pas yes kyi snang ba 'gags/ nga rgyal gyi tha ba bsra bas rnam grol gyi myu gu skye ba'i yul du gyur/ phrog gi mtshon cha rnon pos rang gzhan las ngan sdug bsngal gyi zug rngu la 170)sbyor zhing*/ smon lam log pa'i mtshams sbyor gyi stobs las rang dang lta spyod gcig pa'i 'khor tshogs gdug pa can grangs med pas bskor te/ srin yul laṅka pu ri'i dbus kyi ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtse lor gnas bcas shing*/ 'jigs su rung ba'i lus la g.yang gzhi dang ko rlon ni gyon/ sbrul dang mi mgo thal chen khrag zhag gi rgyan dang rtags su ni byas gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi lag cha ni 'thogs/ kha rlangs sna rlangs spu'i bu ga kun nas nad dag dug gi char sprin spro zhing*/

nyin zhag ro la skye 'gro sems can grangs las 'das pa'i srog dbug sha khrag rus pa nang khrol la zas skal du byas nas khams gsum 'jig rten kun la dbang bsgyur te gnas so/ de lta bu'i ngang tshul ngan pas 'gro ba thams cad phral yul du bzod dka'i 171)sdug bsngal la sbyor ba de dpal chen po he ru kas gzigs nas thugs rjes 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa dgongs te 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du sku mi zad 'bar ba dbang chen pad+ma he ru ka dbu lnga dang ldan pas ye shes lnga lhun gyis grub pa phyag brgyad pas rnam thar brgyad yongs su rdzogs/ zhabs bzhi pas phrin las rnam bzhi rgyun chad med pa/ phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'bar bas 'dul thabs kyi cho 'phrul bsam yas 'gyed pa/ ye shes me dpung rab tu 'bar bas dug gsum gzhob tu bsreg pa'i skur bzhengs te/ srid gsum zil gyis gnon nus pa'i dbang gi rta skad drag po lan dgur grags pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad sprin phung stibs pa bzhin skad cig la 'dus par gyur to/ de'i tshe dpal chen pad+ma he ru kas bka'i 'gro ba 'di ltar mdzad de/ ༈ kye ma lus pa'i tshogs 172)chen dag 'das pa'i dus nas sngon byung ltar/ da lta'i dus 'dir byung ba ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rabs la/ bdag nyid chen po brtag pa yi/ khro bo'i tshul du sngon byung ba/ de tshe sems can thams cad kun/ shin tu khro dag gtum par gyur/ shin tu khro dag gtum pa yis/ 'o dod 'bor par ltung bar 'gyur/ mi zad sdug bsngal mtha' la zhen/ ji lta ba yis thabs kyi gdul/ zhes bgros pa la/ phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs thams cad kyis kyang dgongs pa gcig tu mthun par/ shin tu gtum pa'i sems can 'di/ dor bzhag bag chags ngan pa yis/ bdud 'phel rig 'dzin rgyud gcod cing*/ bstan pa'i gsung rab 'jig par 'gyur/ las kyi mun par 'gro ba 'khyams/ dug nad rim nad phra men ma/

gnod sbyin gnod dang log 'dren gyis/ srid gsum 'jig cing dam tshig 'dral/ 173)ji ltar 'os pa'i thabs kyi thul/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus nas kyang*/ mngon spyod rol pa'i thabs chen gyis/ 'khor ba bsgral ba'i dus la babs/ ces dang*/ shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo las/ khro bor de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad/ khro bo'i tshul tsan khros pas kyang*/ 'jig rten gsum dag sreg byed na/ sangs rgyas thugs rjes khros pas kyang*/ khams gsum ma lus smos ci dgos/ ces bka' bgros shing*/ gsang ba'i bdag po la sogs byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis kyang bde gshegs rnams la gsol ba btab ste/ e ma'o bde bar gshegs pa rnams/ thugs rje chen po'i mnga' bdag can/ ngul la babs pa'iskal chen 'dir/ las la babs pa'i thugs rje yis/ rnam par smin pa'i 'byung po 'di/ bsgral bar mdzad na thugs rje'i 174)mchog zhes sogs kyis bskul ba las phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang dregs pa can de 'dul ba'i gnyen por dpen rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po nyid mngags shing thugs rje dang phrin las kyi nus stobs gcig tu 'dus bar byin gyis brlabs so/ de nas dpal chen po rta mgrin rgyal pos rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs bskyod de ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ri bor mkha' lhing zas la babs pa ltar gshegs nas/ ma tram̐ ru dra chen po de las bka' stsal pa/ gdug pa can khyod 'di lta bu'i lta spyod ngan pa'i brtul zhugs 'di zhog la chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon zhig ces gsungs pas/ ru tra nga rgyal gyi rlom pa ches tsher skyes te/ ci khyod 'dra bas bdag 'dul ba'i mthu nus 'chi bar smra ba'am/ srid pa gsum na bdag las che ba'i dbang phyugs su zhig yod/ ces zer zhing srin po gdug 175)pa'i ngar skad tu lu ru lu zhes pa'i sgra 'brug ltar 'byin pas kha ṭ+wam̐ gi lag cha 'khrol bar byed do/

de nas dbang chen 'bar bas gdug pa can gyi ru dra de zhi ba chen po chos nyid bden pas 'dul ba'i yul du ma gyur gzigs nas/ kho'i gdug pa'i ngar skad ru ru de nyid o dang hūm̐ gi bar du bcug nas ye shes kyi khro bo mus pa'i thugs sngags su byin gyis brlabs te/ de'i sham bur/ dam sri rū dra mā ra ya dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad kyi drag sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong dus gcig la lder ba'i skad ltar bsgrags cing*/ de nyid gdug pa'i lag cha kha ṭ+wām̐ ga 'phrogs te kho rang gi snying la gzir ba tsam gyis/ gdug pa can de ljon shing rtsa ba bcad pa bzhin 'gyil lo/ slar yang dpal chen pos/ dam srid ru dra gaṃ sa ri mā ra ya rba/ lhu 176)dum lhu dum/ shig shig phrul phrul/ tre'u tre'u/ snying sbur rbad dza dzaḥ zhes gsungs pa tsam gyis kho'i gzugs phung de tshal pa brgyad du 'thor ba dpen pos 'dzam bu gling du bor te dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad du byin gyis brlabs/ kho'i gzag pa rgya mtsho lhung ba las pag bsam gyi shing skyed pa'i rtsa sdong yal ga me tog lo 'bras snying po shun lpags dang bcas pa rnams 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi a mṛ ta'i rgyu ru byin rlabs shing*/ gzhan yang don snying nang khrol ba khrag rus bcud rkang tshil rtsa rgyus skra sen pa spu tshun chad 'jig rten gyi khams su de dang de'i rigs mthun gyi sman du 'khrungs par mdzod/ kho'i rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo de la dug lnga'i bag chags sbyangs phyir dpal gyi zhabs su rngub cing sku'i dbyibs brgyud de 'og gi sgor bton pas las ngan gyi 'khrul rtogs bag 177)chags sgrib g.yogs mus dus der zad nas/ sngon gyi zab mo'i chos tshul thobs pa'i don yang bde blag tu dran zhing*/ bar du rang gi lta log spyod nyes kyi tshul mtha' dag ji ltar bar go zhing 'gyod pa'i sems bcod glag med pa skyes nas/ dpal chen po nyid la gdung bas smre ngag mthel bshags mdongs gsol du byas te/

gzi byin rgyal po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag 'dra blun rmongs las ngan sdig po che/ las kyi dbang gis 'dod pa'i khams 'dir skyes/ skyes pas 'gyod do las la yi re chad/ yi chad 'gyod kyang las dbang bcos su med/ las kyi shugs ni chu bo'i klung dang 'dra/ las dbang chu klung 'phral du ga la bzlog rnam smin thams cad rang gi las las byung*/ 'di ltar las kyi rlung dmar 'dis btab pas/ bskal pa grangs med bar 178)du bdag cag rnams/ 'khor ba'i brtson rag mun par 'khyams lags na/ khyed kyi thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa kun byang nas/ ma ltar byams pa'i thugs rjes skyab tu gsol/ zhes sogs ru dra'i smre bshags kyi sgo nas gsol ba btab cing*/ slar yang*/ e ma dpa' bo thugs rje can/ 'bangs la nan tan ma chung zhig bdag gi 'khor dang bran g.yog dang*/ ma dang sring mo bu mo sogs/ 'bangs su 'bul lo bka' la 'thogs/ dbus na mchis pa'i skal med kyi/ nyid kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' la zhog phud la 'tshal ba'i skal ma mchis/ lhag ma zhal chab bron la stsol/ bdag cag bka' las yongs mi gda'/ gal te bka' las 'das gyur na/ bdag cag rnams kyi mgo lus rnying*/ rus myag nas ni tshim par 'gyur/ zhes pa'i mda' 179)dor zhing dam bcas pa la/ dpal chen po rta mchog he ru kas kyang tshad med thugs rje chen pos rjes su bzung ste/ ma tram̐ ru dra ni 'og phyogs thal bas khebs pa ces bya ba'i zhing khams su de bzhin gshegs pa thal ba'i dbang por 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan zhing*/ sprul pa'i rnam rol ni bstan srung chen po ma hā kā lar byas nas bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa ma rdzogs kyi bar du dam pa'i chos skyong zhing 'gal byed tshar gcod pa'i bdag por dbang bskur mnga' gso gnyer gtad gzi byin bskyed cing dam la bzhag ru dra'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i bdag po 'jig rten gyi dregs byed pho mo 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang rang rang gi srog gi snying po mdongs gsol du phul ba la dpen pos kyang dam tshig gi rdo rje spyi bor

180)bzhag cing bdud rtsi lce la blugs nas bka' dang dam las mi 'da' bar dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i srung ma dang dam tshig can gyi gdong grogs/ dam nyams rnams kyi stang gcod du bka' bsgo bar mdzad do/ de'i dus su dpal chen po pad+ma dbang chen rta mgrin rgyal po de nyid kyi sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po mngon par 'du mdzad cing*/ nyid la mi zhan pa'i 'khor gyi dbus nas sprul pa pad+ma'i sems dpa' dang*/ dbang gi lha mo bde byed ma la sogs pas zhu ba por mdzad nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las 'dus pa rta mchog rtol pa chen po'i rgyud dang*/ dbang rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud dang*/ dpal pad+ma dbang chen dregs pa tshar gcod kyi rgyud dang*/ dregs pa dbang sdud/ dregs pa gnas 'bebs/ dregs pa zil gnon/ dregs pa thams cad gzan la 'bebs pa'i rgyud la sogs pa 181)dang*/ dbang chen 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ man ngag gi rgyud/ bkol pa dum bu'i rgyud sogs dang*/ nā ga klu 'dul chen po'i rgyud ma bu rnams dang*/ bde gshegs spyi dril rngog ma leb rgan 'bar ba'i rgyud chen la sogs rta mgrin dbang gi rgyud sde rab 'byams mtha' yas gsungs shing*/ mkha' 'gro dang rig 'dzin gyi tshogs rnams kyi bka'i bsdu ba mdzad de 'dzam gling mi yul du slob dpon chen klu sgrub snying po dang pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs skyes chen grub thob rnams la bka' babs shing*/ rgyud la brten nas sgrub thab man ngag las tshogs dgongs 'grel dpag tu med pa paṇa grub so sos mdzad pa la brten nas/ rgya bod du dpal rta mgrin kho na'i grub thob kyang grangs med par byon mod kyi/

lo rgyus bsdus pa 'chad na 'di gas bzungs te bshad do/ da lam gyi chos bka' 'di kho na'i lo rgyus kyi dbang du bgyi na/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas 182)bod yul du byos khar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis bka' stsal te/ rigs kyi bu rig pa 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug khyod kyis/ byang phyogs kha ba can gyi rgyal khanas dam can dra pas zhabs kyis ma bcags shing shin tu bgrod par dka' ba'i sa phyogs ri brag thams cad mtshon cha gzings pa 'dra ba/ chu klung thams cad rba klong drag por 'khrug pa/ skye 'gro thams cad kyang gdol pa sha zan srin po'i rigs su gtogs pas mdog zhing sha khrag la dga' ba/ g.yo sgyu che zhing sdog pa mi dge ba la spyod pa 'ba' zhig yod pas 'dul bar dka' ba'i zhing yin kyang*/ bdag nyid kyis rgyal ba'i spyan sngar smon lam btab ching dam bcas pa'i 'dul yul du 'gyur phyir/ bdag gi thugs rje las sprul pa khyed kyis kyang rmad byung thugs rje'i rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pas 'thul bar 'gyur gyi/ skye 'gro pho rigs thams cad 'phad pa spyan 183)ras gzigs kyi ting 'dzin gyis thul zhig mo rnams thams cad sgrol ma gsang ba ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis 'thul shig mi ma yin gdug pa can rnams rta mgrin dbang chen 'bar ba'i brtul zhugs drag pos tshar chod la/ dam pa'i chos kyi bstan pa dar bar gyis shig ces gsungs pa dang mthun par slob dpon gyis kyang bod yul mtha' thob kyi skye 'gro pho mo rnams 'phags mchog thugs rje'i bdag po yab yum gyi sgo nas smin grol du mdzad cing*/ bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams ni dbang chen rol ba'i gzi byin gyis btul zhing dam la btags/ khyad par du rgyal po'i thugs dam dpal gyi bsam yas bzhengs pa'i thog mar bar chad sel phyir ār+ya pā lo rta mgrin gyi gling sngon la bzhengs su gsol bas sa gzhi dul zhing bar chad thams cad zhi nas thugs dam gyi gtsug lag gegs med du

184)'byongs/ de dag gi skabs su slob dpon chen pos dpal rta mgrin gyi chos skor rgyud dang man ngag mang po zhig chos rgyal rje 'bangs tha dad kyi skal ba dang 'tshams par gnang bas/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la sogs pas rta mgrin gyi skur dngos su bzhengs shing rta skad kyis 'dzam gling khyab pa'i grub rtags ston nus pa yang byung zhing chos rnams gter kha so sor sbas pa las/ zab chos 'di nyid ni rta mchog gtsug gi nor bu'i rgyud kyi grub rtags ston nus pa yang byung zhing chos rnams gter kha so sor sbas pa las/ zab chos 'di nyid ni rta mchog gtsug gi nor bu'i rgyud kyi dgongs don man ngag bsdebs nas/ phyi mdo dang bstun te ltung bshags sangs rgyas so lnga'i sgrub thabs/ nang sngags lugs dang mthun pa rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub thabs/ gsang ba man ngag dang mthun pa rtsa gsum gcig dril yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang sgrub las tshogs dang bcas pa/ de kho na nyid rdzogs rim ye shes 'khor lo'i nyams len rdzogs pa chen po yang ri 'od gsal 'khor yug gi zab don snying por dril 185)ba dang bcas pa'i chos skor 'di ni myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po la gnang zhing ma 'ong drag spyod bzhi bcu'i yang mtha' sum cu kha ral la nye ba'i dus na zab chos 'di nyid kyis 'gro la phan pa'i lung bstan dbang bskur smon lam bka' gtad mdzad nas/ gter dpe rnams rin chen zangs kyi sbu gur bcug cing gu ru yab yum gyi byang sems dang mtsho rgyal gyi dbu skra sogs byin rlabs kyi khyad par can dang*/ rta phag yab yum gyi sku rten tsit+ta rin chen 'bar ba zhes pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu sogs gter rdzas khyad 'phags du ma dang bcas te rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab nas kong yul nyang lung ljon pa'i nags tshal gyi sked pa snyal mo lha ri zhes 'od dpag med kyi sku brnyan brag la rang byung du gsal ba'i gnas su gter du sbas shing*/

drang srong gza' bdud chen po la gter srung du bka' bsgos te bzhag pa las/ phyi ma'i dus na ji ltar 'byung 186)tshul du rtags lung byang dang rjes su mthun par/ sprul pa'i rig 'dzin chen po hūm̐ nag me 'bar gyis kyang dus rtags lung bstan ji lta ba'i tig tu babs nas zab gter 'di nyid bzhes par brtsam pa la/ bdud rigs log 'dren gdug pa can rnams ma bzod pa'i cho 'phrul drag po g.yos te/ gcugs can mi'i bar chad yul phyogs de dag gi skye bo rnams kyi gter bton na yul gyi sa bcud nyams par 'gyur bas srung dgos zer nas dmag dpung go mtshon dang bcas pas gter gnas kyi lam 'phrang bkag cing sku la bsdams/ gzugs med lha 'dre'i bar chad rluyang 'tshub thog ser shwa 'od ri nyel ba sogs 'tshub 'gyur mtha' yas pas gter sgo dgag kyang*/ rig 'dzin de nyid kyis 'gro ba mis mi thar ba'i g.yang ri la rdzu 'phrul gyis chibs rgyug mdzad cing brag la zhabs rjes 'jogs sogs grub rtags ya mtshan 187)du ma bstan pas mi rnams dbang du bsdus/ khro rgyal rta mgrin 'bar ba'i ting 'dzin nus pa'i zer gyis mi ma yin cham la phabs te bar chad thams cad zil gyis mnan nas zab gter gong med du thob cing bka' babs las 'phro can gyi chos bdag skyes chen so so'i phyag tu phrod par mdzad pa'i rten 'bral dge legs kyi khri gdugs phyogs bcur brdal bas gdul bya'i smin grol gyi lam bzang mngon par snang bar mdzad pa 'di ltar lags/ ༈ de'i phyir na deng gi dus 'dir zab chos 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur la 'jug pa'i las rim gyi thog mar gsang sngags zab mo'i chos la rdo rje'i slob dpon gyi byin rlabs rjes su gnang ba ma thob par bab chol du 'jug tu mi rung la/ bka'i rjes su gnang ba thob par byed pa la gus pas gsol ba gdab gos/ gsol ba gdab pa'i yul 188)bla ma la tha mal mi'i 'du shes byas na byin rlabs 'jug pa'i yul du mi 'gyur phyir/

bla ma ni dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid yin la yin par shes pa'i dag snang mos gus kyi gdung shugs bskyed nas gsol ba gdab pa'i tshig 'di rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ e ma bla ma rin po che/ dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ bdag cag 'khor ba'i btson rar chud/ 'di la thugs rjes gzigs mdzod la/ dbang mchog dam pa stsal du gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i lan du dam tshig gi skal ba'i nus stobs 'dri zhing gnang ba'i skabs dbye ba la gsan par zhu/ ho/ bu khyod su yin cag gi bya/ gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ 'jug pa'i skal ldan las 'phro can/ brgya lam de ni re 'ga' tsam/ rtsa gsum dam tshig bsrung nus sam/ zhes dris pa 'di'i lan du rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam 189)tshig thams cad srog la babs kyang mi nyams par bsrung snyam pa'i zhe thag pa'i dam bca' dang bcas te tshig 'di rjes bzlos mdzad par zhu/ ༈ bdag ni rigs kyi bu gcig pu/ sngon sbyangs las 'phro can yin no/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig dbang gis bsrung*/ thugs rjes dgongs la bdang bskur zhu/ zhes zhu zhing bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la dngos sam yid kyis phyag dang bskor ba ci nus bya'o/ slad gral du 'khod pa la spyan dar dmar pos bcings shing me tog bsil ma lag tu gtad la/ de yang 'o skol skye 'gro thams cad 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas ma rig pa'i bag chags ngan goms mthu brtas nas 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras la yid chags pas rang byung ye shes kyi zhal ma mthong bar bsgrib pa'i brda mtshon pa'i phyir mig dar dmar pos bcing ba yin la/ da nas bla ma'i drin gyis rang 'byung don gyi lha dang mjal bar bya phyir rig pa rang byung gi me tog 'di rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 190)la phyag rten nam dbang yon gyi tshul du phul ba tsam gyis/ tshe rabs sngon nas bsgom shing bsgrub pa'i las 'phro gang yod kyi lhas byin gyis brlabs nas rang rig ye shes rang ngo mthong bar mdzad du gsol snyam pa'i mos gdungs kyi ngang nas tshig 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad pa'i mthar me tog bsil ma dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su mthor bar mdzod cig

ho/ rtsa gsum bla ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ rang rig snang ba'i me tog 'bul/ sngon nas las kyi 'phro yod pa'i/ yi dam lha la babs par shog de ltar me tog phul ba de nyid rigs tha dad pa'i las 'phro gang yod kyi lha la babs shing de'i rigs dang mtshungs pa'i dbang gi gsang mtshan dang las dang dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba yin na'ang*/ deng gi skabs 'dir ni rigs kun 'dus pa rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor la babs pa lags tshe 191)de dang mthun par dbang gi gsang mtshan kyang rigs 'dus dbang chen drag po rtsal zhes pa'i ming 'dzin par zhu zhing gsang ba'i mtshan 'di thogs pa tsam nas lha dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro kun gyi dam tshig gi mthun pa'i sras dang mched du gzigs nas byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur ba dang*/ gnas skabs su bar chad las skyobs cing mthur rag kyang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan 'di nyid dang mthun par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bas na gsang mtshan ni don dang dgos ched mang po dang ldan pa lags/ ༈ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od gser gyi kha dog lta bu la dbyibs ni sman pa mig mkhan gyi thur ma 'dra ba 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i bag chags sgrib g.yogs mtha' dag gsal ba'i mos pa mdzod 192)cig ho/ ji ltar mig mkhan mig dbye ltar/ khyod kyi ma rig ling thog ni/ rig pa'i ngang du dbye bas/ rtsa gsum lha la legs par ltos/ ces/ bla mas phyag mtshan rdo rjes mig dbye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan dar rnams dkrol te/ ༈ rigs kyi bu rnams legs par nyon zhig gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor dang mjal ba ni tshe rabs dpag tu med pa nas bsod nams kyi tshogs chen bsags shing smon lam gyi mthu dang ldan dgos te/ de dang mi ldan par theg chen bla med kyi chos dang mi phrad/ phrad kyang dad par mi 'gyur ma dad pa la byin rlabs 'jug pa'i skabs mi srid pas/ de bas na khyed cag rnams 'di lta bu'i gsang mchog bla na med pa'i chos la dad cing dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i sgor zhugs pa ni bsod nams kyi skal ba mchog rab tu gyur pa yin la/

'on kyang 'di lta bu'i 193)sgor zhugs phyin chad gsang mchog rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig gi rtsa ba yan lag dang bcas pa tshul bzhin bsrung dgos de ma bsrung na mnar med dmyal ba chen por lhung nas thar ba'i dus mi 'byung zhing*/ dam tshig ma nyams par bsrung na tshe gcig bla med byang chub kyi go 'phang thog par nus pas na/ de lta bu'i khe nyen gyi rgyu 'bras la legs par bsam nas/ blangs dor phyin ci ma log par sgrub dogs pa lags/ de nas ye shes 'beb par byed pa'i rdzas dang yo byad spos dang rol mo sogs gsar la/ de yan chad kyi las rim rnams kyi khyed cag dbang gi snod rung du bsgrub pa'i sta gon yin la/ da ni dbang dngos gzhi bskur bar bya ba la yang gsang sngags bla med kyi skabs 'dir rnam pa kun ru sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum ldan ma gtogs tha mal 'khrul pa'i zhen rtog rang ga mas 194)ni skad cig kyang ru pha ma min pa dang*/ khyad par dbang zhes bya ba'i don ni lha la lha bstim/ sngags la sngags su gsal gdab/ chos nyid la chos nyid du ngo sprod pa la dbang du brjod pa yin gyi/ so skye tha mal pa'i mgo thog tu kun rdzob mtshan ma'i rdzas kyi btug cing reg pa tsam gyis ni dbang gi don 'grub par 'gyur ba ma lags tshe/ des na dbang bskur ba'i yul lhar bskyed pa'i dmigs pa 'di bzhin du sgom par zhu/ de yang 'o skol rnams gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'di dag tha mal gyi gnas ma yin par bde chen dbang gi pho brang ye shes 'od kyi gzhal yas su mos pa mdzad/ bdag rdo rje slob dpon la yang phal pa'i mi gzugs kyi 'du shes mi mdzad par bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs kyi ngo bor nges shes bskyed pa gnang*/ khyed rang so so rnams kyang gdan pad+ma nyi zla bdud bzhi brjis pa'i 195)steng du/ skad cig dran rdzogs su lha thams cad kyi spyi dpal dbang chen rta mgrin rgyal po yum mchog rdo rje phag mo dang gnyis ka sku mdog dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'bar ba dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin zhing*/

zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba rno dpal du gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar zlum glog ltar 'khyug cing smin ma ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgya dang rin chen rus rgyan dar dpyang gis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis khro bo'i dor stabs kyis bzhengs shing yab kyi spyi bor rta mgo ljang zhur dang yum gyi gtsug tu phag zhal mthing nag gis mtshan pa'i rang sgra drag pos snang srid g.yo nus pa dbu skra smug nag gyen du 'khyil ba'i dbus na rigs bdag gu ru yid bzhin nor bu pad+ma sam+bha ba'i cha byad zhi 'dzum can/ mnyam bzhag 196)nor bu bsam 'phel 'dzin pas rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa ste/ de ltar rtsa gsum gcig drilasku rib lhun po ltar brjid cing nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od bstan 'bar ba ye shes me dpug gi klong na gtar gu'i nyams ldan gyi skur gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ yig dkar po/ mgrin par āḥyig dmar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ yig mthing ga de'i 'og tu hrīḥyig me'i mdog can rnams las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min bde ba chen po'i zhing dang*/ dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas na skyabs gnas rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul nas/ ye shes thugs rje'i rlabs chen g.yos te rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi 'khor du sangs rgyas byang sems rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung rgya mtshos bskor ba dbyar gyi char sprin thibs pa ltar byon nas/ khyed rang rnams la dam tshig ye shes gnyis med du thim pa'i mos pa dang dad gus gdung 197)ba'i shugs drag po bskyed par mdzod cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ ma hā gu ru tsin+dha ma ṇi/ ha a gṛ wa/ badz+ra bā ra hi/ sa pa ri wā ra e ā ra li hri hring*/ pheṃ pheṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ ka ya wā ho/ ka ya wāka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swā hā/ zhes/ rdzas sngags ting 'dzin thabs dang rten 'brel 'dzoms pa'i sgo nas byin dbab cing*/

me tog la rtsa sngags dang rten 'brel snying po bzlas par rab tu gnas re brtan pa bya'o/ ༈ de ltar rtsa sngags gsum gyi lho tshogs rang dam tshig la ye shes pa bstim pa ni dbang gi dngos gzhi yin la/ khyed rang rnams kyang dmigs pa gsal ba dang sgo gsum tha mal gyi snang ba 'gags pa ye shes zhugs pa'i rtags kyi bye brag ci rigs nyams su myong ba lta bu'i tshe na ni dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs 'di kas thob pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang thob pa de mi nyams brtan par bya ba dang*/ sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum 198)gyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa nan chags su bya phyir slar yang dbang rdzas la brten nas dbang bzhi mtha' brten dang bcas pa 'bul ba yin pas na/ bum pa la sogs dbang rdzas kyi dngos po 'di dag kyang gnas skabs ltar snang tsam du brda dang mtshon byed kyi dper so so'i dbyis su bstan pa ma gtogs/ don la rtsa ba gsum gyi ngo bo nid du bzhugs pa yin te/ de ltar yin pa'i gtan tshig ci yin na/ sngags kyi theg par gzugs snang thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor yin na dbang rdzas lha mos kyang yin la/ de las kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi cho ga zab mo'i sgo nas lhar bsgrubs shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i dbang rdzas 'di dag gis dbang bskur bas/ sgo gsum sgrib pa dag cing rtsa gsum gyi go 'phang 'grub pa'i nus pa rgyud la skyes pa'i nges shes mdzad pa zhu/ oṃ hūm̐/ bum pa gzhal yas khang gi nang*/ 199)bum rdzas rtsa gsum lha tshogs gsal/ dbang bzhi thob nas sgrib bzhi dag pa'i don/ skal ldan bu mchog khyod kyis thob par shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ oṃ oṃ/

zhes/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing rol mo bsgrags/ me tog 'thor ba'i rjes su/ des ni bum dbang lus la bskur bas skyed rim sku'i dbang thob cing*/ lus sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i so bon thebs pa yin pas/ snang ba sku'i 'khyer po dag mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig la gnas par mdzod cig hūm̐ āḥ dus gsum don mdzad rtsa gsum lha tshogs sku/ dad mos can la byin rlabs mngon sum 'byung*/ dag cing gsal la sgrib bral snang stong 'char/ skal ldan bu mchog khyod kyis thob par shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ wāka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ.āḥ.āḥ zhes pas thod pa 200)mgrin par bzhag cing bdud rtsi byin nas/ des gsang dbang ngag la bskur bas rdzogs rim gsung gi dbang thob ste/ ngag long sku 'grub pa'i sa bon thebs pas/ grags pa gsung gi khyer po'i dam tshig la gnas par mdzad 'tshal/ ho/ rang lus phung po lha dang lha mo'i ngang*/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs rigs rnams kun gyi bdag dug gsum dag nas sku gsum lhun gyis grub/ skal ldan bu mchog khyed kyis thob par shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes rdor dril snying khar bzhag cing lag tu gtad do/ des ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang mchog sems la bskur bas/ skyed rdzogs zung 'jug thugs kyi dbang thob ste/ yid chos skur grol ba'i sa bon rgyud la theb pa yin pas/ dran rtogs thugs kyi khyer so'i dam tshig las mi 'da' bar mdzad 'tshal/ ho/ skye med gsal la dran 'dzin zhig 201)sngags bzlas chu bo'i rgyun dang mtshungs/ gsal cha ma 'gag lha sngags dbang*/ skal ldan bu mchog khyod kyis thob par shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes pa'i rtsa ba'i snying po lan gsum du rjes zlos bya ba dang lhan cig bgrang 'phreng gi sna gcig slob dpon gyis zhing sna gcig slob las 'dren pa dang bcas re sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin la/

dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po bcas pa'ang brjod nas/ ༈ de lta bu snying po sngags kyi dbang 'di ma thob par yi dam lha'i bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod la mi dbang zhing*/ byas kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung la/ sngags dbang ngag la thob phyin chad bzlas pa sngags kyi nus pa bde blag tu 'byung zhing lha myur du 'grub bas na dus rtag tu yi dam rtsa ba gsum gyi bsnyen grub la 'bad par zhu/ ho/ snang ba dbang sdud ḍā ma ru/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i thod khrag 'di/ mkha' 'gro dpa' bo'i srog gi rten/ 202)dbang mchog dam pa thob par shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ ha ri ni sa/ ra tsa hrīḥya/ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes pas lag pa g.yas su ḍā ma ru dang g.yon du thod khrag gtad la/ ༈ de lta bu thabs shes yab yum mtshon pa'i phyag mtshan gyis dbang bskur bas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad rang dbang med par lus dang grib ma ltar 'khor zhing zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las thams cad thog med du 'grub par 'gyur bas na/ dam tshig la nye lta bu med pa dang*/ dus bzang rnam du tshogs gtor gyi mchod pa la brtson dgos pa lags/ de ltar sku gsum thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dbang lnga rim can du bskur bas rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs kyi byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug pa'i skal pa can du byas nas/ ༈ da ni rtsa ba gsum po yang ku ru yid bzhin nor bu nyid la 'du zhing*/ chos longs sprul gsum brgyud par bcas pa thams cad gu 203)ru nyid kyi rnam par rol pa 'ba' zhig tu nges pa'i mos gus dang*/ gtor ma 'di nyid kyang gu ru'i sku'i bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang ba rang bzhin med par gsal ba la snying khong rus pa'i gting nas mos gus kyi shugs skyed de gsol ba 'debs pa la 'dun pa rtse gcig yengs med du dril bar zhu/ 'di skabs su las slob kyis dbang gtor dang spos khyer zhing slob dpon gyi ḍā ma ru dang dril bu 'thogs la dbyangs snyan pos gsol ba gdab ste/

༈ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs so/ skal ldan byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol/ longs sku thugs rje chen po la gsol/ skal ldan byin rlabs= sprul sku rta phag yab yum la= skal ldan= rig 'dzin hūm̐ nag me 'bar la= skal ldan= drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la= skal ldan= kun 'dus yid 204)bzhin nor bu la= skal ldan= zhes gsul ba btabs nas gtor ma gu ru yid bzhin nor bu dang tha mi dad pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pa tsam gyis/ gu ru nyid 'od phung du ltem gyi zhu nas khyed rang rnams la gnyis med du thim pa'i mos pa rtse gcig mdzad par zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba 'dren mdzad gu ru thod phreng rtsal/ u rgyan yul byon 'gro kun lam sna 'dren/ rgya gar yul byon thos bsam sgron me sbar/ bod kyi yul byon gdug pa ma lus btul/ sku tshab lung bstan gsung tshab gter du sbas/ thugs kyi dgongs pa dad can rnams la 'bebs/ smin grol dbang dang gdams pa ma lus kun/ skal ldan bu mchog 'di la stsal du gsol/ 'chi med sku yi dbang mchog stsal du gsol/ 'gag med gsung gi dbang= 'khrul med thugs kyi= mi brjed gzungs 205)kyi= dam pa chos kyi= 'dod 'byung nor bu'i= oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ ba ling+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes pas gtor dbang bskur zhing rol mo bsgrags/ me tog gi char dbab bo/ de ltar dbang rdzas spyi bor zhugs pas bum dbang thob lus sgrib dag bde gshegs sku'i rdo rje 'grub/ lus lha sgom pa la dbang 'bras bu sprul sku thob/ mgrin par zhugs pas gsang dbang thob/ ngag sgrib dag bde gshegs gsung gi rdo rje 'grub/ ngag sngags bzlas pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob/ snying gar zhugs pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid sgrib dag bde gshegs thugs kyi rdo rje 'grub/ rdzogs rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob/ lte bar zhugs pas bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/

sgo gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag 206)skyed rdzogs gnyis med sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa yin pas de ltar nges shes bskyed mdzod/ de nas dbang thams cad kyi snying po'i yag snying rig pa rtsal gyi dbang ngam/ don dam ye shes kyi dbang bskur bar bya ba ste/ 'di ni kun rdzob rdzas kyi dbang la ltos mi dgos par rang byung ye shes rang ngo sprod pa'i dbang yin pas na/ khyed rang rnams kyang lus gnad lta stangs dang ldan pa'i ngang nas sems 'di nyid sngar 'das kyi rjes mi 'breng zhing ma 'ong pa'i sngun bsu mi byed/ da lta'i rig pa la dgag sgrub bzo bcos mi bya bar/ rang gsal rjen pa'i ngang du 'jog par mdzod cig phaṭaḥ ces brjod pas slob ma rnams 'gyur rtog snga phyi'i bar mtshams chod nas shes pa gsal dwangs rjen par 'char ba de la 'di ltar ngo sprod par bya'o/ kyai/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i rigs kyi bu rnams sems ma bcos rang babs 209)kyi ngang nas legs par nyon zhig de lta bu'i rtsa ba gsum gyi dbang bskur zab mo brda dang thabs dang cho gdal brten nas legs par bskur ba thob pa yin zhing*/ da ni don dam pa'i rtsa ba gsum ngo sprod par bya ste/ de yang byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma dngos grub gyi rtsa ba yi dam/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro dang gsum po de'i ngo bo'i dngos de gang yin/ gar bzhugs/ mtshan nyid ci lta bu yod snyam na/ rtsa ba gsum po de dag phyi rol gang nas kyang ma byung zhing*/ gang du yang mi gnas/ ngo bo cir yang ma grub/ mtshan nyid cir yang ma yin te/ 'o na gang yin na/ rang gi sems kyi ngo bo ye gdod ma nas spros pa'i mtha' thams cad las 'das pa'i ka dag 'dus ma byas pa'i ye shes stong pa nyid 'di bla ma sku gsum dbyer med kyi ngo bor ye nas lhun gyi 'grub par bzhugs pa yin te/ phyi rol mtshon byed

208)dpe'i bla ma ni 'dus byas drang don tsam du zad la/ 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad ni 'pho 'gyur skye 'jig 'du 'bral mi rtags pa'i chos can las ma 'das kyi/ 'dus ma byas mtshon bya don gyi bla ma 'di la ni rtag chad 'pho 'gyur bri gang skye 'chi 'gro 'ong 'du 'bral sogs skyon gang gis kyang ma gos/ rgyu rkyen cis kyang ma bskyed/ rtsol sgrub gang la'ang ma brten par dus gsum kun tu rang dang 'du 'bral skad cig kyang med par bzhugs cing byin gyis rlob par mdzad pa yin phyir/ don dam rtsol med bde ba chen po'i bla ma zhes kyang bya/ rigs pa thams cad kyi khyab bdag ces kyang bya/ gu ru yid bzhin nor bu zhes kyang bya ba ste/ 'di nyid rang rig rang ngo shes pa ni byin rlabs bla me'i dbang yang dag par thob pa yang yin la/ bla ma sku gsum dbyer med ngo bo 209)nyid sku'i rang zhal mngon sum du mjal ba yin pas de ltar ngo shes par mdzod cig de bzhin du/ rang gi sems stong nyid de'i gdangs 'gag pa med par 'od gsal zhig sgrib g.yogs dag bral bas 'khor 'das kyi chos ma lus pa mi long gi gzugs brnyan nam/ nam mkha'i gza' skar rgya mtshor 'char ba ltar bkra lam mer gsal la ngos bzung dngos po mtshan mar ma grub pa'i stong gsal zung 'jug chen po 'di ni yang dag don gyi yi dam lha mchog dam par gzod ma nyid nas rang shar ba yin te/ snang ba'i cha thams cad yi dam yab kyi rang bzhin/ stong pa'i cha thams cad dpa' mo yum gyi rang bzhin snang stong tha mi dad pa ni yab yum thabs shes zung 'jug tu zhugs pa ste/ gsang sngags phyi nang rgyud sde gong 'og sogs kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ji snyed pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'dir 210)ma 'dus pa 'ga' yang med la/ gnas skabs su mtshan dang rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba sna tshogs bstan pa ni gsal mdangs 'gag med rol pa'i cho 'phrul gang 'dul gyi phrin las yin pa ma gtogs ngo bo tha dad med pa nyid de/

tshul 'di ltar du rtogs shing rig pa ni yi dam gyi lha mus pa'i dbang dang byin rlabs yongs rdzogs su thob pa yin la/ lha dang rang nyid tha mi dad pa gsal stong zung ngag khyab gdab kyi ting nge 'dzin las ma g.yos pa ni yi dam ma sgrub lhun grub chen po'i gnad kyi rtsa ba zin pa'i phyir mchog mthun gyi dngos grub mus rtsol med rang shugs las 'byung bar shes par gyis shig de ltar rang sems gsal stong lha dang bla ma'i ngo bor nges shes/ thag chod gdengs thos pa de'i tshe/ rtsal mdangs cir yang 'char ba'i rol pa nyid mkha' 'gro'i rang bzhin yin par shugs las shes shing rtogs par 'gyur ba 211)de dag gi srog gnad zin par ngang gis 'gyur ba ste/ dper na rgyal po btson du zin na 'bangs 'khor tsham la ngang gis phebs pa dang mtshungs pa nyid de/ de yang sems kyi rtsal mdangs 'gyu byed phrag rag gi rtogs tshogs bzang ngan bsam gyis mi khyab cing grangs med pa cir yang 'char/ gar yang rgyugs/ ci yang byed par snang la/ brtan g.yo 'khor 'das kun la ma khyab pa dang mi byed pa gang yang mi srid pa'i cho 'phrul la dbang bsgyur ba 'di ni mkha' 'gro'i ngang tshul nyid yin pa dang*/ de nyid kyang don la bla ma yi dam gyi rnam 'phrul/ gsal stong dbyer med kyi rang rtsal/ med bzhin snang la rang bzhin bden dngos su ma grub pa'i rnam rol yin la yin par shes pa ni ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi srog dbang thob pa yin pas/ de ltar thob nas ni rang 212)dbang gzhan la mi 'chor bar gzhan dbang rang gis bsgyur phyir/ chogs drug yul snang gi 'char sgo bzang ngan 'bring gsum dang 'gyu dran rnam rtog gi bye brag phra rag sbom gsum ci ltar shar/ gang ltar snang tshul ji lta bur nyams su myong yang de la a 'thas kyi bden zhen dgag sgrub bzang ngan chags sdang blang dor re dgos sogs kyi mtshan 'dzin gang yang mi bya bar/ gang shar sems kyi rnam rol/

sems nyid gdod nas stong pa/ stong pa rig pa'i snying po can du rang ngo rang gis shes/ rang thag rang gi chod/ rang dbang rang gis thob pa'i klong du cham skyur rgya yan khyab gdal du 'jog pa ni mkha' 'gro ma tshogs dbang du bsdud/ cham la dbab/ gnad la 'bebs*/ las la 'gyed pa sogs thams cad gcig car du 'grub pa yin pas de ltar shes par gyis shig de ltar rtsa ba gsum po gzhan 213)log nas mi 'byung*/ mi 'tshol/ mi sgrub/ mi re ste/ rang dang ye nas 'bral ma myong*/ bskyed mi dgos/ bsgrub mi 'tshal ste/ zab mo'i gnad don gyi snying po 'di nyid rtogs shing nyams su blang ba kho na/ gal chen ba lags/ yang 'di snyam du sems te/ ci 'don rtsa ba gsum ye nas rang la yod yod pa/ 'grub 'grub pa/ de ltar yin na/ dbang dang skyed rdzogs sgrub thabs sgom rim bzlas sngags phrin las kha bsgyur sogs mtha' yas pa 'di dag ci'i phyir byed snyam na/ gdod nas rang la rgyu lhun grub tu yod pa de ma rig ma shes pa rtogs par gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rgya mtshor thog ma mtha' med du 'khyams pa 'di la/ rkyen bla ma'i man ngag gi 'tshams sbyar nas/ dpe yis ngo sprad/ tshig gis brda dkrol/ don gyi gnad la dbab nas smin byed kyi dbang bskur/ grol byed kyi man 214)dag bstan pas mi shes pa shes par byas/ shes pa nyams su blangs nas goms pa mngon du gyur tshe rang la yod pa rang gsal 'bras bu 'byin par byed pa'i thabs yin te/ ji ltar 'jig rten pa rnams kyang chu las thar 'dod na rkyal la goms dgos/ dkyus thog gcod pa la rta rtsal sbyang dgos/ g.yul sprod pa la ral skor dang mda' rtsal la sbyangs nas mkhas dgos pa'i dpe bzhin/ 'dir yang spros med kyi rang bzhin gtan la 'bebs par bya la spros bcas kyi sgrogs legs par chod dgos pa'i phyir na/ brda dang thabs la brten pas don rgyud la khel bar byed pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi thabs mkhas thugs rje'i

215) phrin las rmad byang lags pas de ltar dgongs shing rgyud la 'byor bas rang gzhan gyi don 'grub par mdzad 'tshal lo/ de nas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung gi tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung thims ltar byon nas khyed rang rnams la dbang don gyi ye shes ma skyed pa'i skyed cing skyes pa rnams mi nyams shing brtan par rab tu gnas phyir me tog gi char phab cing shis brjod mdzad pa'i mos pa gnang bar zhu/ zhes pa'i ngang nas bkra shis kyi tshig bcad brjod cing me tog 'thor/ sku drin gso ba'i maṇ+ḍal dang tshogs kyi dga' ston bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la btang rag gi mchod bstod dang bka' drung la gtor ma phul zhing*/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes ba gshegs cing dam tshig sa bdag la bsdu ba dang*/ bzod gsol bsngo smon shes brjod la sogs rjes chog gi rim pa spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ de ltar zab chos rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang chog gter gzhung 216) gi sor bzhag nyid cung zar bsdus pa'i gshis kyi slob ma rnams kyi rgyud la go don 'phrod dka' ba dang*/ ga don ma 'phrod na dbang gi dgos don gyi 'byung tshe/ des na dmigs pa dang don 'phrol gyi mtshams sbyor yod pa bzhin gyis shig ces/ 7skyabs mchog rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mnyam med sgom po pa dpal bzang po rdo rje phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal pa nyid kyi bka' stsal ba gus par spyi bor blangs te/ sna tshogs rang grol gyi ye ger bkod pa'i dge bas 'gro kun byang chub mchog la myur du 'khor par gyur cig/ maṅga laṃ//
